OpenCode Subagents-
    Build -> to build with all tools enabled, file operations, system commands
    plan -> to plan the action, no editing access
    general -> for research and complex purposes, multi step tasks
    explore -> to read only codebases, search code by keywords without modifying them
    scout -> read only for external docs

OpenCode Primary-
    compection -> compact long context into a smaller memory
    title -> generates session titles
    summary -> creates session summaries
